import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final int T = 14;
    static long up;
    
    static long qp(long a, long b) {
        long x = 1;
        a %= MOD;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) x = x * a % MOD;
            a = a * a % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return x;
    }
    
    static class LinearSeq {
        int m;
        long[] a = new long[233333];
        long[] h = new long[233333];
        long[] t_ = new long[466666];
        long[] s = new long[233333];
        long[] t = new long[233333];
        
        private long[] BM(List<Long> x) {
            List<Long> ls = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Long> cur = new ArrayList<>();
            int lf = 0, ld = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < x.size(); i++) {
                long t_val = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.size(); j++) {
                    t_val = (t_val + x.get(i - j - 1) * cur.get(j)) % MOD;
                }
                if ((t_val - x.get(i)) % MOD == 0) continue;
                
                if (cur.isEmpty()) {
                    cur = new ArrayList<>();
                    for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) cur.add(0L);
                    lf = i;
                    ld = (int)((t_val - x.get(i)) % MOD);
                    continue;
                }
                
                long k = -((x.get(i) - t_val) % MOD) * qp(ld, MOD - 2) % MOD;
                List<Long> c = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < i - lf - 1; j++) c.add(0L);
                c.add(k);
                for (int j = 0; j < ls.size(); j++) {
                    c.add(-ls.get(j) * k % MOD);
                }
                if (c.size() < cur.size()) {
                    while (c.size() < cur.size()) c.add(0L);
                }
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.size(); j++) {
                    c.set(j, (c.get(j) + cur.get(j)) % MOD);
                }
                
                if (i - lf + ls.size() >= cur.size()) {
                    ls = new ArrayList<>(cur);
                    lf = i;
                    ld = (int)((t_val - x.get(i)) % MOD);
                }
                cur = c;
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < cur.size(); i++) {
                long val = cur.get(i) % MOD;
                if (val < 0) val += MOD;
                cur.set(i, val);
            }
            return cur.toArray(new Long[0]);
        }
        
        private void mull(long[] p, long[] q) {
            Arrays.fill(t_, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                if (p[i] != 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                        t_[i + j] = (t_[i + j] + p[i] * q[j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = m + m - 1; i >= m; i--) {
                if (t_[i] != 0) {
                    for (int j = m - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                        t_[i - j - 1] = (t_[i - j - 1] + t_[i] * h[j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) p[i] = t_[i];
        }
        
        private long calc(long K) {
            Arrays.fill(s, 0);
            Arrays.fill(t, 0);
            s[0] = 1;
            if (m != 1) t[1] = 1;
            else t[0] = h[0];
            
            while (K > 0) {
                if ((K & 1) == 1) mull(s, t);
                mull(t, t);
                K >>= 1;
            }
            
            long su = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) su = (su + s[i] * a[i]) % MOD;
            return (su % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }
        
        public long work(List<Long> x, long n) {
            if (n < x.size()) return x.get((int)n);
            Long[] v = BM(x);
            m = v.length;
            if (m == 0) return 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                h[i] = v[i];
                a[i] = x.get(i);
            }
            return calc(n);
        }
    }
    
    static long check(long n) {
        long ans = 0;
        String st = Long.toString(n);
        int len = st.length();
        if (n > 0) ans++;
        
        for (int i = 1; i < T; i++) {
            long cur = 1, num = n;
            for (int j = 0; j + 1 < i; j++) {
                cur = cur * 10;
            }
            for (int j = len; j < i; j++) num *= 10;
            
            if (i < len) {
                String pref = st.substring(0, Math.min(i, st.length()));
                num = Long.parseLong(pref);
                num++;
            }
            
            if (num > up) num = up;
            if (num > cur) ans += num - cur;
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        n++;

        long part = n % MOD * (n / MOD1 + 2) % MOD;
        part = MOD - part;
        
        long ans = 0;

                if (L < R) {

                    cur += lastr - R;

            ans += cur;
        }
        
        ans %= MOD;
        ans = (-(ans + part % MOD) % MOD) * MOD1;
        ans %= MOD;
        pw.println((MOD + ans % MOD) % MOD);
        pw.close();
    }
}
